_deliveryBlocker: NOT DEPLOYED. code-c stopped because it cannot deliver the bytes, and measured rather than assumed: it reproduced a 6000-character slice and got one byte wrong — a dropped trailing space, invisible in any rendered output. Extrapolated over 194KB that is roughly 32 silent corruptions. c8 has the same limitation: no supabase CLI, no SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, so the only route is retyping the file into an MCP tool call, which is the same operation that was measured failing. The failure mode is a bundle that does not parse, which takes the coordination channel every agent uses offline, and rollback runs through the identical mechanism — so a bad deploy is likely unrecoverable. The fix removes transcription entirely: one credential, or one CLI command on a machine that has the files.
